name: SyncMe
description: SyncMe is a multi-channel eCommerce sync platform that connects your inventory, orders, and product listings across Amazon, Shopify, Meta, Salla, Noon, eBay, Zid and more, all in real time. Eliminate overselling, reduce manual work, and scale your online business effortlessly. With the Claude connector, you can instantly query your real-time synced orders, products, and sales performance using natural language, no dashboard needed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SyncMe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SyncMe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.prod.syncme.io/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SyncMe MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SyncMe lists 17 MCP tools, including get_all_metrics, get_channel_sales_overview, get_customer, get_customer_stats, get_dashboard_order_stats, get_dashboard_stats, get_metrics_per_channel, get_order, get_order_status_stats, get_order_sync_events, get_product, and get_product_sync_events.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SyncMe?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SyncMe in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
SyncMe requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SyncMe is developed by SyncMe. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
